meta.help.instagram:
Switch Instagram to a Professional (Business) account and link it to your Facebook Page.
In Instagram → Settings → Messages and calls → Connected tools, allow access to messages.
In developers.facebook.com → your app, add Instagram (Messenger API for Instagram).
Generate a Page access token with pages_messaging and instagram_manage_messages.
Paste the Instagram account ID, Page ID and token below, and tap Connect.
meta.help.messenger:
Your Facebook Page must be in your Meta business account.
In developers.facebook.com → your app → Add product → Messenger, connect the Page.
Generate a Page access token with pages_messaging (System user token recommended so it does not expire).
Copy the Page ID, paste both below, and tap Connect. Orbit turns on the Page's message webhook for you.
meta.help.title: Where do I find these?
meta.help.whatsapp:
Open developers.facebook.com → My Apps → your app (Business type) → Add product → WhatsApp.
In WhatsApp → API Setup, add and verify your business phone number. Copy its Phone number ID.
In business.facebook.com → Settings → System users, add a user, give it your app and WhatsApp account, then Generate token (never expires) with the two WhatsApp permissions.
Optional: in WhatsApp Manager → Message templates, create a Utility template whose body is just {{var}}; enter its name here once approved.
Paste the details below and tap Connect.

sms.help:
Register your business on a DLT portal (e.g. Jio, Vodafone Idea or Airtel) and get a Principal Entity ID.
On DLT, register a 6-letter header (sender ID) and a Service-Implicit template such as: Dear customer, {{var}}{{var}}{{var}}{{var}} - Your Business.
Create an MSG91 account, add your DLT entity ID, and add the same template with its DLT template ID.
Create an auth key in MSG91 → API, then fill in the details below.
